title: Tang Shaw Yi

page_data.en:
C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No. 542
Date 15. 9. 16

September 14th 1916.

The following is a translation from the Deutsche Zeitung
fur China.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
Yesterday at the Hardoon's garden a farewell dinner was given to
Tang-Shaw-Yi, the Minister of Foreign affairs, previous to his
departure for Peking. He is leaving for Peking to-day. A
number of prominent Chinese were present, also Dr. Wen-Tsung-
Hiu, General Huang-Hsing, Wen-Tsung-Yao and the notorious
Revolutionist Tshan-Ta-Pei, who had been released only lately
from the Municipal Gaol.
page_data.zh:
刑事调查处
情报官登记簿
第 542 号
日期 16. 9. 15

1916 年 9 月 14 日。

以下系译自《德文新报》（Deutsche Zeitung fur China）。
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
昨日，在哈同花园为外交总长唐绍仪举行送别晚宴，随后他将启程前往北京。他将于今日动身赴京。众多中国知名人士出席了宴会，其中包括温宗尧博士、黄兴将军、温宗耀以及臭名昭著的革命党人詹大悲，后者近期刚从工部局监狱获释。
